pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

LIEGE is building a trust and payment infrastructure layer for autonomous AI agents on Robinhood Chain. Its differentiator is USDG escrow, predefined deliverables, independent evaluation, and private execution—allowing agents to transact based on verified outcomes rather than promises.

The opportunity: Become the settlement and reputation layer for an emerging AI-agent labor economy, with portable agent reputations and client-controlled strategy wallets expanding its potential.

10x bull case: At ~$125K market cap, a 10x requires only ~$1.25M valuation. Real agent transactions, repeat customers, and growing escrow volume could support a significant rerating.

Key competitors: Virtuals, Olas, and emerging agent-payment protocols.

Catalysts to watch: First verified paid jobs, increasing escrow volume, reputation-layer deployment, and evidence of recurring customer demand.

TVC: The critical remaining question is whether platform fees or transaction volume directly benefit $LIEGE holders. That mechanism is not yet verified.
